title: Botany genetics M3A: supported stat mutation runtime
acceptance_criteria: Resolved source seed profiles retain inherited defaults and explicit PestTolerance, Viable, and Seedless values; live consumers honor viability, pest tolerance, seedless extraction denial, and zero-yield behavior.
Holder mutation level and modifier preserve fractional values, codec round-trip, source defaults, and clamping/reset lifecycle; modifiers affect mutation-level accumulation, not table odds.

A due cycle polls actual reagent metabolism first, then performs source-ordered typed mutation rolls with exactly one strict-double-less-than chance call per table entry, including odds zero and one; successful changes replace the current immutable genetics without changing previously emitted copies.
Supported numeric and boolean stat mutations match source float-bin midpoint-to-even rounding and integer-yield bias, use the existing PlantStatMutation owner, and retain unrelated profile values.
Living-target cycle preflight rejects failed chemical mutation resolution before partial mutation commit; empty/dead guards, current genes, growth, and copy-on-write behavior remain correct.

Source-ordered unsupported capabilities produce honest diagnostics; Slippery is reported unsupported, not stored as a genetic record, and its record consumer remains unimplemented; unsupported effect-body RNG consumption is outside the implemented parity boundary.
Actual UnstableMutagen metabolism with fixture holder modifier 3 triggers the first-cycle viable toggle and lifecycle reset; this fixture does not claim the upstream Left4Zed descriptor.

Separate registered native tests cover arranged stat-packet transmission, seedless extraction admission, and zero-yield behavior; baseline chemical roundtrip and 1000W/750W power regressions are preserved.

The visible fixture identifies its stat-modifier preset and actual pending/triggered source/status without presenting a gameplay genome scanner; gas, species, pollen, special capabilities, full catalog, and assets remain unimplemented.
Validation distinguishes focused automated evidence from unverified full mutation capability parity, full-suite, visual/connected-client, and owner acceptance.
The current main, JVM, and registered native fixture sources compile and the runtime jar artifact is produced.
manual_steps: Run `/ms14 botany_fixture`; wait about 15 seconds, then inspect status for the stat-modifier preset and pending/triggered source. Inspect the stat fixture and chemical tray; use ordinary harvest/extraction, including seedless denial if the arranged fixture offers it.
